limitations: Native browser chrome zoom is not directly controllable through Playwright page keyboard/CDP. Headed Chromium launches successfully, but Control+Equal only targets document content and no native zoom change was observable; a manual browser-chrome run remains OPEN.
axe-core was unavailable in the existing web dependency tree and was not installed. CDP AX-tree plus DOM heuristics are structural evidence, not a WCAG conformance certificate.
Contrast values are a leaf-text/effective-ancestor-background heuristic; gradients, composited overlays, canvas text, anti-aliasing and font-weight thresholds are not fully modeled.
The nested MT5 repository has unrelated dirty WIP, including ReplayWorkspace.css; this lane did not stage, reset or modify those files.
